title: Past Simple — Irregular Verbs
grammarNote:
Неправильные глаголы (Irregular verbs) — особые формы Past Simple. Их нужно запомнить!

Группа 1 — гласная меняется (A→O):
come→came · run→ran · swim→swam · sing→sang · drink→drank

Группа 2 — bought/thought/caught:
buy→bought · think→thought · bring→brought · catch→caught · teach→taught

Группа 3 — все формы одинаковые:
put→put · cut→cut · hit→hit · let→let · hurt→hurt · cost→cost

Группа 4 — запомни отдельно (самые важные):
go→went · be→was/were · have→had · do→did · say→said
make→made · take→took · know→knew · give→gave · see→saw
get→got · find→found · tell→told · write→wrote · read→read
leave→left · feel→felt · keep→kept · think→thought · become→became

💡 Учи тройками: work / worked / worked (regular) · go / went / gone (irregular)

grammarTable.subject: Base form → Past Simple
grammarTable.example: She went to the museum. They came late.

grammarTable.subject: see → saw / have → had
grammarTable.example: I saw a rare sword. He had a great idea.

grammarTable.subject: take → took / give → gave
grammarTable.example: She took notes. He wrote the answer. (*same spelling)

grammarTable.subject: buy → bought / think → thought
grammarTable.example: I bought a book. She felt excited.

grammarTable.subject: NEGATIVE: didn't + BASE
grammarTable.example: She didn't go. They didn't come.

grammarTable.subject: QUESTION: Did + subject + BASE?
grammarTable.example: Did you go to the museum? Did she see the sword?

grammarTable.subject: SHORT ANSWERS
grammarTable.example: Did you see it? — Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.

grammarExtra.title: Group 1 — Vowel Change (i → a → u pattern)

rows.example: The exhibition began at 10 a.m.
She drank tea while reading.
The children sang traditional songs.
He swam in the river as a child.
They ran to catch the bus.
We sat in the front row of the lecture hall.

grammarExtra.title: Group 2 — Same form for Past (base = past)

rows.example: I read the whole book last night.
She cut the bread carefully.
He put the artefact back on the shelf.
The flood hit the city hard.
She let them look at the photographs.
The museum ticket cost 500 tenge.
Amir went to the museum yesterday.
She was a teacher. They were students.
The city had a large market in the 19th century.
She did her homework after the museum visit.
Dr. Akhmetov said the sword was very old.
Merchants made the city wealthy.

grammarExtra.title: Critical Rules — Never Make These Mistakes

rows.example: She didn't go ✓ / She didn't went ✗
Did she go? ✓ / Did she went? ✗
She went ✓ / She did go ✗ (emphasis only)
She was a teacher ✓ / She did be a teacher ✗
Was she happy? ✓ / Did she be happy? ✗
I read every day [riːd]. / I read it yesterday [red].

grammarTip:
ТОП-20 неправильных глаголов — знай наизусть:
go/went · come/came · have/had · get/got · say/said · make/made
take/took · know/knew · give/gave · see/saw · do/did · find/found
tell/told · write/wrote · think/thought · become/became
leave/left · feel/felt · put/put (не меняется!) · read/read (не меняется!)

💡 Совет: учи по группам и повторяй вслух каждый день!

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct irregular Past Simple.

exercises.text: Dr. Akhmetov ___ (say) that the sword was very old.
She ___ (see) an amazing sword in the museum display.
Zhibek ___ about the Pugachev Rebellion at school.
exercises.hint: Negative: didn't + BASE form. 'know' is the base form of 'knew'.

exercises.instruction: Write the correct irregular Past Simple.
exercises.text: Apai Raushan ___ (have) a very busy life as a teacher.

exercises.hint: Question: Did + subject + BASE form. 'take' is the base of 'took'.

exercises.text: The merchants ___ (make) Uralsk very wealthy in the 19th century.
Kamila ___ (feel) deeply moved by her grandmother's stories.

exercises.hint: After 'didn't', always use the BASE form: go (not went).

exercises.text: Pushkin ___ (write) a famous book after his visit to Uralsk.
Zhibek ___ (think) the museum would be boring, but it was amazing.
The children ___ (sing) traditional songs at the school concert.

questions.text: He ___ to Uralsk to research the rebellion.
She ___ (say) that every child is a miracle.
Kamila ___ (see) an old photograph in her grandmother's house.
They ___ a great time at the museum.
"She didn't went home" is correct Past Simple negative.
questions.hint: After 'didn't', use BASE form: 'She didn't go home.'

questions.text: The guide ___ (tell) them about the Pugachev Rebellion.
Kamila ___ (feel) proud of her grandmother's courage.
___ Zhibek know about the rebellion before the visit?
questions.hint: Past Simple question: Did + subject + BASE form.

questions.text: Amir ___ (think) the museum would be interesting.
She ___ (buy) a souvenir from the museum shop.
"read" has the same spelling in present and past tense.
questions.hint: read [riːd] (present) → read [red] (past). Same spelling, different pronunciation.

questions.text: Pushkin ___ (write) a famous book about the rebellion.
She ___ (find) an old photograph in the box.
Which sentence uses irregular verbs correctly?
opts: I goed and I seed it.
I went and I saw it.
I went and I seed it.
I goed and I saw it.
questions.correct: I went and I saw it.
questions.hint: go → went, see → saw. Both must be irregular forms.
sing → sang, sit → sat (both vowel-change irregulars).

questions.text: She ___ (give) Kamila the old photograph as a gift.
